title: Hallmark verification
description: The verifier's ruling on each of the reviewer's blocking findings, by the number the prompt gave it. A finding ruled not real is dropped from the verdict.

rulings.description: One ruling per numbered finding. Leave none out.

index.description: The finding's number in the prompt.

real.description: True when the scenario holds; false when you can show what makes it impossible or the claim false.

reason.description: One sentence naming the file and line you checked.
